blocks.text: NAGOYA, Japan– Track and field wrapped up on a rainy Tuesday at the Asian Games with the two powers in the sport in the region — China and Japan — going head to head in the final race, the men’s 4×400 relay. Japan took gold in the final in 3 minutes, 00.75 seconds with silver for Qatar (3:00.93) and bronze for India (3:01.61). China was fifth. Two other relays also helped cap off the night. The 4×100 mixed relay went to China (40.78), and India won the women’s 4×400 (3:29.69). The women’s 4×400 is one of the oldest world records still […]...
